## Recommendation

**Act now:** size the crew to S-lean-human (three people, ρ≤0.85 after
pick-lines scaling). At €647K in five-year present-value cost, it is the
least-cost modeled capacity-feasible option. **For robot-inclusive
alternatives:** S-future-2028 is lowest at €2.533M, but remains costlier than
the human baseline. Do not approve procurement solely on wage-arbitrage
assumptions; local vacancies and warehouse telemetry are the decision-critical
validation inputs.

## Decision at a glance

| Scenario | 5-year NPV | Total-cost reduction vs baseline (NPV) | Decision |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| **S-lean-human** | **−€647K** | **62.5%** | Implement now |
| S-baseline-human | −€1.726M | 0.0% | Legacy reference |
| **S-future-2028** | **−€2.533M** | **−46.7%** | Lowest-cost robot case |
| S-pure-humanoid | −€2.878M | −66.7% | Not preferred |
| S-hybrid-amr | −€3.841M | −122.5% | Integration burden |

All values come from
[`tco_scenarios.csv`](../exports/tableau_public/tco_scenarios.csv). They are
cost NPVs, so a less-negative number represents lower cost.

## Scope and evidence

The project combines 2,359 publicly available UnifoLM demonstration episodes,
a SimPy AutoStore model, and a five-year TCO model using Austrian labor inputs.
The data are household demonstrations rather than warehouse tasks; the model
therefore applies a 0.50–0.90 WBT-to-production transfer factor.

## Method

1. Capability extraction summarizes cycle-time evidence.
2. Discrete-event simulation checks operational feasibility.
3. The financial model calculates capex, recurring operating costs, residual
   value, and the five-year cost NPV.
4. OAT, paired Monte Carlo (common random numbers), and two-way frontiers test
   sensitivity without changing scenario identity.

## Key limitations

Availability derating, wage growth, system integration (€200K for robot
scenarios), and residual value are modeled. They are assumptions, not
measurements. The published frontiers do not identify a S-future-2028 /
S-lean-human cost tie within the €60K–€180K humanoid-capex grid. A local pilot
should replace the transfer proxy before a capital commitment.
